name: Arjun Verma
bio: Arjun's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for go-karting in Chennai. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in automotive dynamics. His early career involved optimizing vehicle performance in various racing series, including Formula Bharat. He transitioned into team management, quickly rising through the ranks due to his meticulous approach and keen understanding of race strategy. Arjun's pragmatic nature allows him to make calculated decisions under pressure, balancing risk and reward to maximize team performance. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment, empowering his team members to contribute their best to achieve shared goals.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Arjun is of medium build with a focused gaze and an air of quiet confidence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations and ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against the table when deep in thought.
